title: Phase 11B.5 Final Families, Audit, Determinism Re-run and Report Procedure

revision_history.note: Specification v1 adopted by the project owner with decisions D1-D6 approved as written; D5 chose this formal amendment.

amends: nothing; fills in the procedure behind design_freeze.json stages.11B_5_final_families_audit_report (steps: Holm over 198 / 5742, audit, determinism sample rerun, report), which the design names but does not detail

owner_decisions.D1: APPROVED - determinism sample size and selection rule as specified
owner_decisions.D2: APPROVED - bit-identical comparison, excluding only the warnings field
owner_decisions.D3: APPROVED - confirmation period remains NOT_EVALUATED / NOT_APPLICABLE; sealed content not accessed
owner_decisions.D4: APPROVED - on determinism failure preserve all frozen results and withhold Phase 11B acceptance until investigated
owner_decisions.D5: APPROVED - this formal Amendment 06 freezes the procedure; final/protocol.json is the execution record conforming to it
owner_decisions.D6: APPROVED - refuse the determinism rerun if Python or package versions differ from the frozen environment

inputs.phase_11b_results: data/results/research/phase11/11B/development_results.json (sha256 504ab08a8d358a882af8977079a65fc6e28d4db58cf9063ad7c5ff82a8737d96 at adoption); its registry_sha256 must equal the frozen registry file hash and every artifact hash must verify
inputs.gate_status: taken as recorded in the frozen evidence; never re-evaluated

aapl_excluded_sensitivity.role: descriptive only; raw p and gate status reported, no Holm

families.membership: the set of assembled ids must equal the frozen design id set exactly; 11A and 11B ids disjoint; no duplicates
families.integrity_failure: FAMILY_INTEGRITY_FAILED - the run stops; a family is never shrunk, padded or imputed
families.p_value_requirements: finite float in [0, 1]; anything else stops the run

holm: training.phase9_research.holm_adjust unchanged (step-down; ties keep input order; adjusted values capped at 1)

qualification.rule: qualified = gate_status == QUALIFIED AND p_value_raw < 0.05 AND p_value_holm_final < 0.05
qualification.comparisons: strict less-than; a value of exactly 0.05 fails

confirmation.applicability: NOT_APPLICABLE when there are 0 development qualifiers; otherwise PENDING_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION
confirmation.sealed_content: never read; no sealed path is opened

audit_checks.A1: verified_inputs() passes (design freeze, Amendments 03-05, Phase 11.0 design, Amendment 01, price report, 11A registry, feature verification, 29 feature frames)
audit_checks.A2: 11B registry loads: FROZEN, matrix sha256 169c369f89056749754f8324edccee1cd85eacaa4d80a8f9e8be995118f87b08, prerequisites PASS with pinned hashes
audit_checks.A3: development_results.json: status COMPLETE, counts 3828 / 132 / 132, registry_sha256 matches, confirmation NOT_EVALUATED, data_kind real
audit_checks.A4: all 53 artifact hashes match; no development.incomplete directory
audit_checks.A5: entries re-derived from the artifacts equal development_results.json exactly
audit_checks.A7: recomputed descriptive 11B-stage Holm equals the stored values exactly
audit_checks.A8: every pre-existing file under phase11/11A and phase11/11B (outside final/) hashes identically before and after the run
audit_checks.failure: AUDIT_FAILED - the run stops before Holm and writes only the failure evidence

determinism.unit: per-stock run (symbol, feature set, horizon) re-executed as in 11B.4 _stock_job; panel run (kind, feature set, horizon) re-executed as in 11B.4 _panel_job

sample.S1_coverage: for each (fs, h) in order B, C, D, F x 1, 3, 5: symbol = universe[int(sha256('phase11b5|determinism_v1|' + fs + '|' + str(h)).hexdigest(), 16) % 29], universe in frozen order
sample.S2_boundary: the per-stock runs containing the 3 smallest Phase 11B per-stock raw p-values (ties broken by frozen order); runs already in S1 are skipped and not replaced
sample.S3_panel: (a) the primary-panel run containing the smallest Phase 11B panel raw p (ties broken by frozen order); (b) the panel_exAAPL run at cell index int(sha256('phase11b5|determinism_v1|panel_exAAPL').hexdigest(), 16) % 12 of the (fs, h) cells in order B, C, D, F x 1, 3, 5

conditions.inputs: verified inputs equal the registry inputs
conditions.environment: Python and package versions equal registry.environment, otherwise ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH and no rerun

determinism.comparison: canonical JSON (sorted keys, JSON round trip of the 11B.4 writer) of the stored run object vs the rerun object, both without the top-level warnings key; must be identical; sha256 of both recorded; panel runs compared on the fields produced by evaluate_panel
determinism.warnings: stored vs rerun warnings.total reported, never a failure
determinism.outcome: DETERMINISM_VERIFIED or DETERMINISM_CHECK_FAILED with every differing field path; never alters frozen results or the qualification decision

outputs.directory: data/results/research/phase11/11B/final/ (write-once; built in final.incomplete/ and renamed on success)

unchanged_invariants: gate_v1, its thresholds, reference baselines and the Diebold-Mariano test
targets, horizons, feature sets, models and parameters
the frozen families, their sizes and membership
the development cutoff and the sealed confirmation period
